title: THURSDAY INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY. SHORT TIMED BURSTS, HONEST RESTS. STEP-UPS, INCLINE PUSH-UPS, STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, FIGURE-FOUR, WALL CHEST OPENER. GET THE HEART KNOCKING, THEN OPEN UP THE HIPS AND CHEST.

script.welcome: THURSDAY, GRIMES. INTERVALS. SHORT BURSTS, HONEST WORK, PROPER RESTS. SIXTEEN MINUTES. NOT A CALORIE BONFIRE, JUST A WAKE UP CALL FOR THE TICKER. THEN WE STRETCH YOU OUT LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR. UP. MOVE.
script.rest: REST. HANDS ON HIPS, NOT ON THE KEYBOARD.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. EMPTY THE TANK. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HEART PUMPED, BALANCE TESTED, HIPS AND CHEST OPEN. FRIDAY IS TOMORROW AND YOU EARNED IT. NOW GO DRINK SOME WATER AND STAY AWAY FROM THE BISCUIT TIN.
script.pause: HOLD. CATCH YOUR BREATH. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: TIMED STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR, HAND ON THE RAIL. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, STEP DOWN CONTROLLED. ALTERNATE LEADING LEG. STEADY RHYTHM FOR 30 SECONDS, NOT A SPRINT.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH. HAND ON THE RAIL, WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, STAND TALL AT THE TOP. STEADY RHYTHM. THIS IS A MARCH, NOT A STAMPEDE.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. HEART AWAKE. GOOD.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UPS (5TH STAIR, TIMED)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, SHOULDER-WIDTH. BODY ONE STRAIGHT PLANK FROM HEAD TO HEELS. LOWER THE CHEST TO THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS BACK UP. SMOOTH REPS FOR 30 SECONDS; PAUSE AT THE TOP IF FORM SLIPS.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STEP. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH. BODY LIKE A PLANK, CHEST TO THE STEP, PRESS AWAY. IF YOUR HIPS SAG LIKE A WET HAMMOCK, PAUSE AT THE TOP AND FIX IT.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. CHEST AND ARMS PULLED THEIR WEIGHT. GOOD.

exercises.name: SLOW STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, PLANK POSITION. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE CHEST, RETURN, SWITCH. SLOW AND CONTROLLED, HIPS LEVEL, BREATHE. QUALITY OVER SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. KNEE TO CHEST, SWITCH. SLOW AND TIDY. YOU ARE CLIMBING A HILL, NOT RUNNING FROM THE TAXMAN.
exercises.speakDone: CLIMBERS DONE. THAT IS THE HARD BIT FINISHED. GOOD MAN.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL BOTH ARE LEVEL. HOLD 2 SECONDS, HIPS SQUARE, NO TIPPING. RETURN SLOW, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. ON ALL FOURS. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH SIDE. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG OUT LONG. HOLD FOR TWO. HIPS SQUARE. NO WOBBLING LIKE A DRUNK ON A BAR STOOL.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADY AS A ROCK. NEARLY.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP STRETCH
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK, KNEES BENT. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. THREAD YOUR HANDS BEHIND THE BOTTOM THIGH AND DRAW IT GENTLY TOWARD YOU UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP OF THE CROSSED LEG. HEAD DOWN, SHOULDERS RELAXED. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. ON YOUR BACK. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER KNEE, PULL THE THIGH IN GENTLY. FEEL THE OUTSIDE OF THE HIP. RELAX THE SHOULDERS. THIS IS THE BIT YOU LIKE, SO DO NOT RUSH IT.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO THE WALL. FOREARM FLAT ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. STEP THROUGH WITH THE NEAR FOOT AND TURN THE CHEST GENTLY AWAY UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL, STEP THROUGH, TURN AWAY. SHOULDER DOWN. UNDO ALL THAT HUNCHING OVER THE SCREEN LIKE A GOBLIN WITH A SPREADSHEET.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN, SHOULDERS BACK. THAT IS THE LOT. DISMISSED.
